description: This file defines the PimReportData class responsible for generating and normalizing report data related to the 'Pim' module in the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods to retrieve report data, get metadata, and manages external dependencies like ReportGeneratorService and PimReportSearchFilterParams.

classes.name: PimReportData
classes.description: A class that implements report data generation and normalization for the Pim module, utilizing report filter parameters and report generator service.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the class with PimReportSearchFilterParams.

methods.name: getReportGeneratorService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ReportGeneratorService instance.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Returns normalized report data based on the filter parameters.

methods.name: getMeta
methods.description: Returns metadata about the report, specifically the total count, wrapped in a ParameterBag.
